reviews.review: First I want to say I did enjoy this game, but I feel there is a LOT left to be desired. The game can be enjoyable with friends, but highly doubtable you'd play more than a single session of this game. The whole game is very repetitive, which i would expect out of a game like this. But there is no change of playstyle or change in pattern throughout the game at all making it feel quite lackluster. Once you understand the basics of the game, it is incredibly easy to the point its almost hard to lose. The killer is very easy to avoid and even if the killer DOES get you, you're able to self revive almost instantly, providing almost zero fear of death to the player. On top of this repetitive playstyle, to fully complete a game you must wait 1 hour to reach the end. I feel if the days were shortened to 20-30 minutes it would grant far more replay-ability, as well as reworking the killers ai, or rework the healing system as it totally takes away from the fear of being caught besides the jumpscare itself. I definitely think this game has a lot of potential but right now feels like its still quite bare bones. I look forward to updates in the future to possibly give it a chance again
